name: staynest
description: StayNest - PG & Hostel Finder and Management System (all practicals merged into one deployable MERN app)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run install:all && npm run build
